# Goa Villagio Resort & Spa

> > A luxury resort and spa in Betalbatim, South Goa, offering family-friendly accommodations and comprehensive guest services.

Goa Villagio Resort & Spa is a unit of IHM located in Thondwaddo, Betalbatim, providing upscale hospitality with a focus on family amenities, security services, and comfortable room options for both leisure and business travelers.

- [Family Suite Room](https://goavillagioresort.com/accommodation/family-suite-room): Spacious family suite rooms with luxury amenities at Goa Villagio Resort
- [Deluxe Room](https://goavillagioresort.com/accommodation/deluxe-room): Deluxe rooms with garden view in Betalbatim, Goa for business travelers
